title: Fylgja findings document v1 (--json) — M10 extension
description: Additive to M1's findings format: every M1 document still validates. Added: operations twin.create, twin.provision, twin.destroy; statuses failed (exit 3) and unclean (exit 4); subject.bundle and subject.run_id; blocks twin (success of create/provision), cleanup (failure of create/provision, and destroy), dry_run. findings_version stays "1". M4: operation twin.show; the `show` block (show.schema.json); the `following` block on twin.create and twin.destroy; `dry_run.follow`. findings_version stays "1": every M1–M3 document still validates. M5: the step enum gains push; dry_run.nodes[] gains artifact (what would be pushed, by name, content type, checksum and size); twin.nodes[] may carry artifact {name, checksum} and pushed_in_s. findings_version stays 1: additive. No artifact content anywhere. M6: dry_run gains lossy_mappings and shared_ports; nothing else changes. M7: the step enum and every block are unchanged; twin show’s host.nodes[] gains psp (show.schema.json); the summary counts and the dry run’s read line are text. New warning artifact.interface.unrepresented and rejection host.image.absent are ordinary findings. M10: operations waypoint.list and waypoint.plan; subject.waypoint (the reference as supplied on --waypoint); the step enum gains resolve, the CLI-side step between the flag guards and the run, as verify is twin.provision's; dry_run.follow.reason gains waypoint; the `waypoint` block (the resolved reference, on twin.create, twin.create --dry-run and intent.read with --waypoint), the `waypoints` block (waypoint.list) and the `plan` block (waypoint.plan), each defined in waypoints.schema.json under its $id; verified.waypoints on schema.check. findings_version stays 1: additive. No artifact or bootstrap content anywhere.

status.description: ok→0, rejected→1 (before the host was touched), error→2 (operational), failed→3 (after the host was touched; cleanup complete), unclean→4 (something remains). See cli.md.

bundle.description: The bundle directory given to twin.provision, as given

run_id.description: The Temporal run id of the provisioning or destroy run this document reports on, once one was started (or attached to)

waypoint.description: M10: as supplied on --waypoint (twin.create, intent.read), <series>/<sequence>; branch and at then carry the resolved reference. Absent otherwise

bundle_id.description: twin.compile (status ok), twin.create and twin.provision (any status once compile completed): the bundle's identity (D-024).

waypoints.description: M10: whether the default branch's schema carries the waypoint kind with every attribute this build reads. Information beside the conformance answer; never a finding

missing.description: the attributes the kind lacks; empty when present, or when the kind itself is absent

twin.description: twin.create / twin.provision, status ok: the twin that was built. Mirrors twin.json's nodes.

dir.description: Absolute twin directory path, as the worker reported it

observed_at.description: As twin.json: null when no read took place

artifact.description: M5: the artifact pushed, by name and checksum.

cleanup.description: twin.create / twin.provision with status failed or unclean, and twin.destroy: what teardown and unstage did.

teardown.description: done: lab fylgja removed. nothing: no lab was present. failed: see cleanup.incomplete. skipped: not attempted (the CLI stopped waiting)

removed.description: What was removed, e.g. "lab fylgja (3 containers)", "twin directory /…/twin"

remaining.description: What is still on the host. Empty for status ok and failed; non-empty for unclean

dry_run.description: twin.create --dry-run / twin.provision --dry-run: what a real run would do. M6: `lossy_mappings` and `shared_ports` count what the bundle’s manifest records, so the operator sees a lossy twin before creating it.

artifact.description: M5: the artifact that would be pushed to this node, as the bundle’s manifest names it.

verdict.description: refused: the findings carry the identifier the real create would refuse with

lossy_mappings.description: the number of entries in the manifest’s fidelity.lossy (0 when absent)

shared_ports.description: the number of distinct (node, port) pairs more than one interface renders to

step.description: New at M2: the step the finding belongs to. Absent on M1 operations; resolve (M10): the CLI's waypoint resolution before a run

following.description: twin.create: the following the run began (state started) or could not begin (not_started); twin.destroy: the following stopped. Absent when the twin does not follow and none was stopped.

show.description: twin.show: see show.schema.json. Referenced by its $id: a relative reference would resolve against this schema's $id to https://fylgja.dev/contracts/findings/show.schema.json, which nothing defines

waypoint.description: M10: the resolved waypoint reference, present on twin.create (with or without --dry-run) and intent.read when --waypoint was given and the resolution succeeded. Defined in waypoints.schema.json by its $id
